And David said unto Michal, / It was... → "And David said unto Michal, It / was..." — "It" is subject of next clause, should not attach to previous line; this looks like a forward push not backward — actually re-reading: "It" was originally on L2 with "was before the LORD"; post-fix moves "It" to end of L1. This is a REGRESSION — "It" is sentence-initial subject pronoun, belongs with "was".

pattern: prep "from" pulled away from gerund-NP "following me"
brief_rationale: turn / from following me → "turn from / following me" splits prep from its complement

pattern: upon us displaced into wrong clause
brief_rationale: pre-fix had "upon us" misplaced; post-fix moves "upon us" with "his heavy yoke which he put" — actually re-reading carefully: post-fix correctly groups "his heavy yoke which he put upon us, and we will serve thee" together — this is an IMPROVEMENT in syntactic grouping. Mark as IMPROVEMENT.

she said / unto them → "she said unto them, / Thus saith..." — moves "unto them" backward; but original L1 was just "And she said" — collapses speech-frame from 2 lines to 1. Loses ATU partition for speech-frame. Mark as NEUTRAL — common speech-frame collapse, neither clearly worse.
